text: Invariant runs on Codex by default, by @gitdek's call on 2026-10-29: his Claude account shouldn't be at risk, and Claude Code stays an option. watch, formalize and synthesize take -agent codex unless told otherwise. A watcher runs only the agents -agents names, codex alone by default, so it never starts Claude Code's CLI unless its operator adds claude-code, not even to check its sign-in. An issue or project that picks an agent the watcher may not run is answered as one it can't run, and a manifest that names one no longer stops the watcher, as D-0137 had any agent it couldn't run do; an agent it may run but can't, or one Invariant doesn't know, still does. A one-off formalize or synthesize runs Claude Code only with -agent claude-code.
